100 Extra Trains Announced for Kerala During Onam Festival

Ahead of the Onam festival, 100 additional train services have been announced to facilitate travel to Kerala. These special services will connect Kerala with major cities like Bengaluru, Chennai, and Hyderabad. The initiative aims to manage the increased passenger demand during the festive period.
